title: The Morning Digest: October 29, 2026
dek: Wednesday's settles were Brent Dec26 $115.32 (up $1.44) and WTI Dec26 $102.78 (up $2.88). Asia faded about one percent overnight, Brent $114.10 and WTI $101.45 at 0351 GMT (Reuters, Oct 29), on peace talk headlines against the escalation calendar. The EIA report for the week ending Oct 23 drew crude by 1.892 Mbbl, built gasoline by 3.870 Mbbl against surveys expecting a draw, and drew distillate by 1.462 Mbbl, with refinery utilization at 92.8 percent and PADD 2 at 88.1 percent. The Ras Tanura refinery claim remains unconfirmed on its second day. December WCS at -$31.00 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 27) on 2 lots. The diesel crack fell to $90.58. The first waiver cargo has dropped its New York destination, and Iran's strait authority threatens action against the largest Hormuz carrier from Nov 1.
